Han-Tien Chen Promotional Headshot

Han-Tien Chen appears in a professional portrait set against a plain gray backdrop. He wears a gray checkered vest over a black shirt and tie, with neatly styled hair and a composed expression. The lighting accentuates his facial features, creating a polished and formal look.

This image is featured on iQIYI’s actor information page, which provides his name in both English and Chinese (陳漢典), his birthdate (1984-07-06), and his zodiac sign (Cancer). The page also offers sharing options and a QR code for mobile sharing.

Chen Handian’s Fashion Portrait

Chen Handian stands in a studio setting wearing a light blue button‑down shirt paired with black trousers and a decorative belt chain. He holds a distinctive two‑tone tie—navy and burgundy—with the phrase “life goes on” embroidered along its length, creating a focal point in the composition.

His neatly styled hair and composed expression complement the minimalist backdrop, highlighting the contrast between the soft shirt color and the bold tie. The image captures a blend of contemporary menswear and personal branding, reflecting both his public persona and a subtle fashion statement.

source.description:
Chen Handian in Red Suit

Chen Handian poses confidently in a tailored red suit, white dress shirt, and black bow tie, leaning casually against a wood-paneled wall. His relaxed smile and hands-in-pockets stance convey a moment of ease amid his typically hectic routine.

Known for sharing his demanding daily life on YouTube, Chen Handian balances hair and makeup sessions, promotional appearances, store openings, dance rehearsals, and even a cycling event in Taichung. This polished portrait reflects his formal event attire and charismatic presence off-camera.
